What truly sets this app apart is its clean interface, smart notifications, and easy-to-use features, making time management a breeze. Whether you’re planning your day, setting reminders, or organizing long-term goals, Structured makes everything so simple and efficient!

title: Structured - Daily Planner
body:
I've been using Structured - Daily Planner for a while now, and I absolutely love it! The interface is clean and user-friendly, allowing me to quickly plan out my day without any clutter.

What I appreciate most is how the app organizes tasks in a visual timeline, giving me a clear overview of my day at a glance. Whether it’s work, meetings, or personal errands, Structured keeps everything in one place, and I love how intuitive it is to rearrange or update tasks as needed.

Overall, this app has been super helpful in keeping me productive and on track. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a reliable and easy-to-use daily planner!

title: Awesome overall!  Requesting some features
body:
The design and functionality are really great.  This is what I’ve been looking for a todo organizer.

Some requests for future updates:
1.   Add bi-weekly repeat
2.  This may be a far fetch but if you can add a functionality, like a tagging mechanism, and based on that tag it will pre-apply the color scheme, icon etc.  it’s a little tedious creating tasks and making sure that you are applying the same icon, color scheme for related todo’s like household, work etc.
